description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Grid class, which is part of the PEAR PHP OO Graph Rendering Utility. It implements a grid element for plotting, associated with primary and secondary axes, and includes methods for setting axes, retrieving axis points, and updating coordinates.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Grid
classes.description: A grid displayed on the plot area, associated with primary and secondary axes, used for rendering grid lines in a graph.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Grid
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grid element.

methods.name: _setPrimaryAxis
methods.description: Sets the primary axis that the grid refers to.

methods.name: _setSecondaryAxis
methods.description: Sets the secondary axis for the grid.

methods.name: _getSecondaryAxisPoints
methods.description: Retrieves the points on the secondary axis that the grid should connect.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Calculates the X pixel position for a given value, considering axis type.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Calculates the Y pixel position for a given value, considering axis type.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of the grid element based on parent plot area dimensions.
